g.text: Why aren't we using Postgres for the vector store, and what are we using now?
Postgres/pgvector wasn’t kept because at 2M vectors its p99 latency was ~800ms, over the 200ms target. We now use Qdrant, with binary
quantization to stay on a single node within budget.
We moved off Postgres/pgvector because at 2M vectors it hit ~800ms p99, exceeding the 200ms budget. We now use Qdrant.
Decision lineage (walked on the graph, not guessed)
[SUPERSEDED] use postgres + pgvector for the embedding store
↳ [LIVE ] migrate the embedding store from postgres/pgvector to qdrant
• keep vector infrastructure under $200 per month
• northwind contract p99 latency sla under 200ms
• stay inside the $200/month budget set by dan
